switch: packages/game/src/rendering/blocks.js: blocksState (default on:false). To apply the King's code, set the defaults there: on:true, then the fields named below. For a test without editing: localStorage dk_blocks = '1' (everything, blocks of 0.5) or a JSON object such as {"on":true,"DBLK":0.3333333333333333}, or in the console setBlocks(true,{...}).

variants.A: current look, the part stays off
variants.B: blocks of 0.5 world unit (2 per tile)
variants.C: blocks of 1/3 world unit (3 per tile), only where the row shows a C; row 8 C is the autumn picture of B

1.what: terrain close-up: block textures on grass, dirt, stone, sand, snow, gravel; dirt path and cobble path as whole blocks

2.what: cliffs and water edge: stone / dirt / sand block sides, pixel grass lip on the top block, pixel water. Same part as row 1 (terrain); if 1 and 2 differ, ask the King

3.what: trees on the block grid (oak, birch, pine; trunk 1 block wide; canopies merged per chunk)

4.what: rocks, gold ore, bushes, stumps as blocks; flowers, tufts, mushrooms, reeds on the pixel grid. Same part as row 3 (decor) and same block size DBLK; if 3 and 4 differ, row 3 decides the size and the difference goes back to the King

5.what: building textures at 16 pixels per block (bricks, planks, tiles, thatch); the models are unchanged

6.what: village at game distance: no part of its own, it shows rows 1 to 5 together. A = keep everything off, B / C = confirms the block size of rows 1 and 3

7.what: full map view: no part of its own (cost check: same draw calls, about 40 % fewer triangles)

8.what: seasons drawn on the blocks: snow on grass, canopies and rocks in winter; yellow grass and orange / red leaves in autumn

9.what: night: no part of its own (check only)

example: 1B 2B 3C 4C 5B 8B  ->  blocksState defaults: on:true, terrain:true, BLK:0.5, decor:true, DBLK:1/3, build:true, seasons:true
